title: 'Love Me Love Me 3,' the next sequel in the hit romantic drama series, coming to Prime Video
summary: The third film will continue the young adult saga based on Stefania S.'s international best-selling novels.
body_markdown:
---


## Key takeaways


- Prime Video has greenlit


Love Me Love Me 3


, with filming set to begin soon.


- Mia Jenkins, Pepe Barroso Silva, and Luca Melucci return in the lead roles.


- The sequel is based on Stefania S.'s best-selling series with over 25 million reads on Wattpad.


---


Hit young adult romantic film series


[Love Me Love Me](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/love-me-love-me-prime-video) will continue, with


[Prime Video](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/tag/prime-video) announcing the upcoming sequel


Love Me Love Me 3


.


Ahead of the release of


[Love Me Love Me 2](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/love-me-love-me-2-sequel-prime-video) ,


which debuts in 2027, Prime Video has greenlit a third chapter which will start filming soon.


[Watch the teaser trailer for ‘Masterplan’ starring Stanley Tucci, coming to Prime Video October 16](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/masterplan-stanley-tucci-prime-video)


Academy Award nominee Stanley Tucci stars in this heist movie as a master thief who recruits two unsuspecting strangers to steal the Mona Lisa—igniting a chaotic family reunion.


The film will continue with the story based on author Stefania S.’s best-selling four-book series of the same name


,


which has more than 25 million reads on Wattpad.


Here’s everything you need to know about the upcoming film.


## What is 'Love Me Love Me 3' about?


Based on the third novel in the book series and shot in English,


Love Me Love Me


3 will continue the story that began with the first chapter.


It will follow on from


Love Me Love Me 2


which sees June return to St. Mary's in the aftermath of the chaotic events that ended the first film. Her mother April, determined to keep her away from James, tightens her grip on June's life. Around them, the group of friends reassembles—with old tensions and new arrivals threatening the fragile balance.


## Who is in the 'Love Me Love Me 3' cast?


Reprising their roles from the previous two films are lead actors:


- Mia Jenkins as June


- Pepe Barroso Silva as James


- Luca Melucci as Will


They will be joined by returning supporting cast members:


- Andrea Guo as Amelia


- Michelangelo Vizzini as Blaze


- Madior Fall as Jackson


- Vanessa Donghi as Ari


The new young adult romance is directed by Roger Kumble, who also helmed the first two


Love Me Love Me


films.


It is co-produced by Lotus Production—a company of Leone Film Group—and Amazon MGM Studios, with the support of WEBTOON Productions.


## When is the 'Love Me Love Me 3' release date?


There is currently no release date for


Love Me Love Me 3


, which will be available exclusively on Prime Video worldwide. Filming will begin soon on the sequel.


[Top 10 Original films and series on Prime Video: See the weekly rankings](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/prime-video-top-10-movies-shows)


From action-packed films to buzzy series, here are the Original titles Prime Video members watched most from September 28–October 4.


Before this chapter debuts,


Love Me Love Me 2


will be released on Prime Video globally in 2027. The first


[Love Me Love Me](https://www.amazon.com/Love-Me-Roger-Kumble/dp/B0GFCKGN7T/ref=sr_1_3?crid=1T99AAHLBLQYC&dib=eyJ2IjoiMSJ9.i-CAhgh7ksBg8NrQaikGgmZ1I2osmtTbewhL34G2KLtICUKSA9aH3BXwMtTIr3e98PXffQzwoIPtUh36Q5SbueHcKTaQd_ZMnVy-j6NLc7jEC4NJuMbMRMs3kMWKWIX7hFOnpxxVkzMXGj079Q-nEqaR19J6-t_fMsNl1Ia2d9z5jxIbw9yu2vsgnqZ3tdOBRioHvhyp6TJaBK_43p3tzp83c-wdYEv3VK1wk40G3IA.lrN9GjD6KHASqTV89cEXNP5WI0bqp0FX6IajvLoFaLY&dib_tag=se&keywords=love+me+love+me&qid=1788516249&sprefix=love+me+love+m%2Caps%2C178&sr=8-3) film is available to watch now worldwide on the platform.


Prime Video is included with an


[Amazon Prime membership](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/how-to-sign-up-for-a-prime-membership) , which costs $14.99 monthly or $139 annually in the US. Discounted memberships are also available for


[young adults](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/amazon-prime-for-young-adults) and


[qualifying government assistance recipients](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/amazon-prime-access-discounted-membership) at 50% off. Check your local Amazon website for information on Prime membership pricing in your region.


Not a member yet? Start a


[30-day free trial](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/amazon-prime-free-trial) today.


## What else is streaming on Prime Video?


If you enjoy young adult romances like


Love Me Love Me


, Prime Video offers plenty of similar titles exploring love such as


[Maxton Hall](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/maxton-hall-prime-video) and the


[Culpables](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/everything-to-know-about-the-culpables-trilogy) franchise, which has been watched by over


[100 million viewers](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/culpables-international-originals-viewing-figures-prime-video) worldwide.


[For more news, visit About Amazon Italy](https://www.aboutamazon.it/)


Amazon is guided by four principles: customer obsession, passion for invention, commitment to operational excellence, and long-term thinking. This is our story.


Prime Video is a


[first-stop entertainment destination](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/tag/entertainment) offering customers a vast collection of premium programming in one app available across thousands of devices. Prime members can customize their viewing experience and find their favorite


[movies](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/tag/prime-original-films) ,


[series](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/tag/prime-original-series) , documentaries, and


[live sports](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/live-sports-streaming-prime-video) .


These include


[Amazon MGM Studios](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/tag/mgm) –produced series and films, licensed fan favorites, and


[programming through subscriptions](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/what-are-prime-video-channels) on Prime Video such as Paramount+,


[MGM+](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/everything-you-need-to-know-about-mgm-plus) ,


[Apple TV](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/apple-tv-shows-amazon-prime-video-subscription) ,


[HBO Max](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/hbo-max-on-prime-video-channels) ,


[Peacock](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/peacock-shows-movies-prime-video-subscription) ,


[FOX One](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/fox-one-news-sports-entertainment-prime-video-subscription) ,


[DAZN](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/prime-video-dazn-sports-subscription) , and


[Crunchyroll](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/crunchyroll-anime-subscription-amazon-prime-video) , as well as more than 900 free ad-supported streaming television (FAST) channels in the U.S.


All customers, regardless of whether they have a Prime membership or not, can rent or buy titles via the Prime Video Store, and can enjoy even more content for free with ads.
